entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 200708636406382720: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RX Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1546.7 +/- 118.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1546.7 +/- 118.7 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.6182 +/- 0.0211 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98), 29.3 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1.307, -3.198 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 68.1 +/- 5.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RX Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 68.1 +/- 5.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 302 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 138, Name='RX Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 302 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,500 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.263 +/- 0.012 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffede1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,500 K and log g 1.5 (u1 0.498, u2 0.223): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1.5 from 2023A&A...678A.195D, the median of its 4 spectra; the 7 published values span log g 1.2 to 2.33, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.9% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 200708636406382720: 4 G-band harmonics of a 11.62400752131378 d period, peak-to-peak 0.566 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.03 of a cycle there.
